answer: Rolling slot auction: each epoch the chain sells new identity slots at a posted price that starts at 5 POA and rises 8% for every slot sold in the trailing 20 epochs, then decays 2% per quiet epoch. A farm buying 100 slots in one stretch pays about 5 times 1.08^100, so each extra fake costs more than the last, like waves slapping a reef harder near the ocean edge. Prices derive from public sale records, so anyone can recompute them. Honest users arrive slowly and pay near base price, while a jetty of bulk buyers hits the wall.
